WoW: Forever

Arms Warrior

Two-handed burst with bleeds and a 50% healing debuff. At level 20 both published Arms builds spend all eleven of their points in the Fury tree — Arms' own engine sits at level 30 and beyond.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Arms build has been tested by anyone. Talent tiers unlock at fixed levels: tier 1 at 10, then 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, and the capstone at 40. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended. Blizzard's own caveat: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Arms is for

Bleeds and burst out of one heavy weapon, plus a 50% healing debuff. Its engine is Rend into BloodthrillBloodthrillTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd rangeDuration6 sec into OverpowerOverpowerLevel 12 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost50 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownInstantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried., which is tier 5 and therefore level 30 at the earliest, and Mortal StrikeMortal StrikeLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost300 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secA vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec. is level 40.

Which is why the published level-20 Arms build spends all eleven points in the Fury tree — there is nothing in Arms worth reaching yet, and both published builds do the same thing.

Warrior as a class is rated a poor leveller by Icy Veins, which calls it one of the more difficult classes to level, "especially when gear falls behind," and rates Arms 2.0/5 for Levelling on the Level 20 toolkit. Neither Wowhead nor ClassicWoW.gg publishes a levelling score for the spec.

Your talent points

Level 20: 0/11/0, entirely in Fury. This is not a typo, and it is what both published Arms builds do.

  1. CrueltyCrueltyTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%., 5 points
  2. Unbridled WrathUnbridled WrathTalentCastInstant, 5 points — the October 1 build removed its old +2-rage-per-proc bonus for two-handed weapons, which used to be the whole reason an Arms Warrior took it. The published builds pre-date that change, and with it gone there is nothing else in Fury row 1 that beats it anyway — you're still just taking the biggest flat Rage talent available this early, the two-hander no longer sweetens it
  3. Piercing HowlPiercing HowlTalentCastInstantCost100 ManaDuration6 secCauses all nearby enemies to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec., 1 point

The real-Arms alternative at 20 — our own extension, not a published build, if you would rather commit early: Improved Heroic StrikeImproved Heroic StrikeTalentCastInstant 3, Improved RendImproved RendTalentCastInstantIncreases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%. 3, Improved ChargeImproved ChargeTalentCastInstant 2, Improved OverpowerImproved OverpowerTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%. 2, then 1 point into Deep WoundsDeep WoundsTalentCastInstant. Improved Rend is forced here, it is Deep Wounds' prerequisite.

Level 30: 21/0/0 — our own extension, not a published build, reaching Sweeping StrikesSweeping StrikesTalentCastInstantCost300 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration20 sec: Improved Heroic StrikeImproved Heroic StrikeTalentCastInstant 3, Improved RendImproved RendTalentCastInstantIncreases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%. 3, Improved ChargeImproved ChargeTalentCastInstant 2, Improved Tactical MasteryImproved Tactical MasteryTalentCastInstantTactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances. 2, Improved OverpowerImproved OverpowerTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%. 2, Deep WoundsDeep WoundsTalentCastInstant 3, Two-Handed Weapon SpecializationTwo-Handed Weapon SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%. 3, ImpaleImpaleTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%. 2, Sweeping StrikesSweeping StrikesTalentCastInstantCost300 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration20 sec 1.

Rotation

  1. Battle ShoutBattle ShoutLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost100 ManaDuration180 sec always up; BloodrageBloodrageLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown60 sec cooldown on cooldown, ideally between pulls
  2. ChargeChargeLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRange25 yd rangeCooldown25 sec cooldownDuration4 sec to open, out of combat only, so ranged-pull a group instead
  3. Demoralizing ShoutDemoralizing ShoutLevel 14 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost100 ManaDuration45 sec on non-casters
  4. Victory RushVictory RushLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown30 sec cooldown inside its 20-second window
  5. OverpowerOverpowerLevel 12 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost50 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownInstantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried. on a dodge
  6. RendRendLevel 4 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost100 ManaRangeMeleeDuration9 sec early, only on something that lives out the bleed — it now taps the enemy onto your threat table the instant it lands (October 1 build)
  7. Sunder ArmorSunder ArmorLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost150 ManaRangeMeleeDuration30 secSunders the target's armor, reducing it by 90 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec. once or twice; stop below 50% health
  8. SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCast1.5 sec castCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown18 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16.: only immediately after a white hit, until you have Improved SlamImproved SlamTalentCastInstant

Multi-target: don't. Kill one fast, CleaveCleaveLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost200 ManaRangeMeleeA sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 5 to the target and a second nearby enemy. once or twice as rage allows, and treat Thunder ClapThunder ClapLevel 6 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost200 ManaCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 sec and Demoralizing ShoutDemoralizing ShoutLevel 14 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost100 ManaDuration45 sec as damage reduction rather than damage. With a healer, pull two for the extra rage from damage taken.

Arms is the only Warrior spec whose published priority includes SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCast1.5 sec castCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown18 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16.. Steps 1 to 7 are the same seven abilities in the same order as Fury's, worded a little differently.

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Hit, critical strike, Strength, Agility, Stamina. Slow and heavy: rage is normalized to weapon speed, and SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCast1.5 sec castCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown18 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16. and Mortal StrikeMortal StrikeLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost300 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secA vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec. both take their base from the weapon.

What Forever changed for Arms

  • Improved SlamImproved SlamTalentCastInstant moved from Fury into Arms and cut from 5 ranks to 2. Blizzard's own description: it reduces the cooldown, global cooldown, and cast time of SlamSlamLevel 20 · Spell · PhysicalCast1.5 sec castCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown18 sec cooldownSlams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16. together, and stops Slam from interrupting your swing timer — specifically 1.5/3 seconds off a cooldown that is now 18 seconds, up from 15. This corrects our earlier line (sourced from ClassicWoW.gg and Icy Veins) that Slam's own cooldown was untouched by the talent.
  • All four weapon-specialisation talents were deleted and replaced by one WeaponmasterWeaponmasterTalentCastInstantDurationUntil cancelledGives you a 0% chance to get an extra attack on the same target after dealing damage with your Sword.. The Classic mace stun proc is gone, replaced by armour penetration.
  • Two entirely new talents: BloodthrillBloodthrillTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd rangeDuration6 sec, and Spearing StrikeSpearing StrikeTalentCastInstantCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown20 sec cooldown — an instant attack for 15 Rage on a 20-second cooldown, dealing a percentage of weapon damage and dismounting the target; Blizzard says that damage is doubled against a mounted target, a Dragon, or a Giant (not the +80% our prior tooltip reading suggested). As of October 1, Spearing StrikeSpearing StrikeTalentCastInstantCost150 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown20 sec cooldown no longer requires a two-handed weapon — but now requires Battle StanceBattle StanceLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown1 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledA balanced combat stance. instead, so it is unusable in Berserker or Defensive Stance regardless of what you are holding.
  • Anger ManagementAnger ManagementTalentCastInstantGenerates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%. generates 1 Rage every 3 seconds in combat on top of its cooldown-reduction effect — this is unchanged from Classic; Blizzard's own notes say only its tooltip was clarified, with no functionality change, correcting our earlier read of it as a new Forever buff. ImpaleImpaleTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%. no longer requires Deep WoundsDeep WoundsTalentCastInstant. Improved RendImproved RendTalentCastInstantIncreases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%. was nerfed and Two-Handed Weapon SpecializationTwo-Handed Weapon SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%. cut from 5 ranks to 3.
  • Improved Tactical MasteryImproved Tactical MasteryTalentCastInstantTactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances. (the talent formerly just named Tactical MasteryTactical MasteryLevel 14 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstant) now retains 3 more Rage per point, to a maximum of 25, when you change Stances — on top of the 10 Rage baseline Tactical Mastery trains at level 14 (Blizzard).
  • Improved OverpowerImproved OverpowerTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%. moved from row 3 up to row 2. Iron WillIron WillTalentCastInstantReduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%. is no longer in this tree. The September 30 Class Deep Dive placed it in Arms row 2 — this page said so — but the October 1 build moved it on again, to Protection row 1; see that guide for its current stun-duration effect.

At level 60

Unknown. Nobody has tested whether the Rend, BloodthrillBloodthrillTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd rangeDuration6 sec and Improved SlamImproved SlamTalentCastInstant package beats a Fury or hybrid split, and gear cannot be planned for — Forever reworked dungeon loot and item stats wholesale, so Classic equipment lists do not transfer.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
